title: Vehicles
description: Ground vehicles and helicopters (spec DAT-024..DAT-029). Helicopter travel hours, the pilot Technical minimum, fuel per tile and the noise ranges are single values in strategic-rules (STR-008, STR-032, STR-034), not per record. No profile field (STR-033 removed).

fuelRangeRegions.description: DAT-024: tiles on a full tank; one fuel unit per tile moved (STR-032)

armourClass.description: DAT-024, 1-6; null or absent = no armour

armourCockpitOnly.description: DAT-024: the armour class protects the cockpit only (design draft: Mi-8 class 2)

mineBlastFactor.description: DAT-026: blast damage to passengers × this with mine protection (design draft 0.5)

healWhileTravellingFactor.description: DAT-026: ambulance layout, healing rate × this while travelling (design draft 2)

noise.description: DAT-024; notice range per class: strategic-rules noiseRange (STR-008)
